cards.zh: 想跟进一下这个的进度
cards.en: Just [[checking in]] on this one.
cards.mine: I want to ask the progress of this.

cards.zh: 温馨提醒，这个周五截止
cards.en: Just a [[gentle reminder]] this is due Friday.
cards.mine: Warm reminder, this is due Friday.
cards.note: 温馨提醒别直译成 warm reminder

cards.zh: 提前跟你说一声，我今天要早走
cards.en: [[Just a heads-up]], I'm leaving early today.
cards.mine: I tell you in advance, I'm leaving early today.

cards.zh: 发你参考一下，上线改到周四了
cards.en: [[FYI]], the release has moved to Thursday.
cards.mine: For your reference, the release has changed to Thursday.
cards.note: FYI 口语里也常直接念出来

cards.en: Sorry, this [[slipped through the cracks]].
cards.mine: Sorry, I missed this thing.

cards.en: Sorry for the [[slow reply]].
cards.mine: Sorry to reply you so late.

cards.zh: 你有空的时候帮我看下这个 PR
cards.en: Could you [[take a look]] at this PR [[when you get a chance]]?
cards.mine: When you are free, please help me see this PR.
cards.note: when you get a chance 更客气

cards.en: I'll be [[on leave]] next week.
cards.mine: I will ask for leave next week.
cards.note: ask for leave 是申请，on leave 是在休

us.en: I'll be [[out of the office]] next week.

cards.en: For anything urgent, please [[reach out to]] Sam.
cards.mine: If urgent things, please contact with Sam.

cards.en: Thanks heaps for [[sorting this out]].
cards.mine: Thank you for your help on this matter.
cards.note: on this matter 太像公文

us.en: Thanks so much for [[taking care of]] this.

cards.en: You're [[a lifesaver]]!
cards.mine: You saved my life!

cards.en: Just [[bumping this]] in case it got buried.
cards.mine: I push this message up again.

cards.zh: 我把 Chen 也拉进来了
cards.en: I've [[looped]] Chen [[in]].
cards.mine: I've added Chen into this topic.
cards.note: loop sb in 让某人知情

cards.en: I'm [[on it]].
cards.mine: I am handling it now.

cards.en: [[Quick question]], is this still needed?
cards.mine: I have a small question want to ask you.
cards.note: 开头直接 Quick question 就行

cards.zh: 你今天能帮忙 review 一下吗？
cards.en: [[Any chance]] you could review this today?
cards.mine: Is it possible you can review it today?
cards.note: Any chance 委婉又不卑微

cards.zh: 我确认一下，周一上线对吧？
cards.en: [[Just so I'm clear]], we're going live Monday?
cards.mine: I want to confirm my understanding, the release is Monday?

cards.zh: 我介绍你们俩认识一下
cards.en: Let me [[put you two in touch]].
cards.mine: Let me introduce you two to know each other.

cards.zh: 不好意思打扰一下，有空吗？
cards.en: Sorry to [[bug you]], but have you got a sec?
cards.mine: Sorry to disturb you, do you have time?

us.en: Sorry to [[bug you]], but do you have a sec?

cards.en: I'm still [[waiting to hear back]] from them.
cards.mine: I'm still waiting their reply.

cards.en: [[All good on my end]].
cards.mine: No problem from my side.

cards.en: Thanks for [[bearing with me]].
cards.mine: Thanks for your patient waiting.
cards.note: patient 是形容词，名词是 patience

cards.en: Is this still [[on track]] for Friday?
cards.mine: Is this still in the plan for Friday?

cards.zh: 我把会议提前到周三了
cards.en: I've [[brought]] the meeting [[forward]] to Wednesday.
cards.mine: I've advanced the meeting to Wednesday.

cards.en: Could you [[sanity check]] this for me?
cards.mine: Can you help me check this?
cards.note: 快速看有没有明显问题
